SELECT s.trade_id, s.title, s.price_point, s.thumb_img, s.recommend_cnt, s.regdate, m.nickname AS seller_nickname, t.toplct_name, c.item_ctg_name FROM saletrade_board s JOIN member m ON s.seller_id = m.member_id JOIN top_location t ON s.toplct_id = t.toplct_id JOIN saletrade_item_category c ON s.item_ctg_id = c.item_ctg_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 'N'
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND c.item_ctg_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY s.trade_id DESC
